heading: Tool Spotlight: Budget Tracker Template
body: A ready-made Excel budget tracker with the 50/30/20 split already built in — just enter your income and expenses, and your savings rate calculates automatically. No formulas to build, no setup beyond typing in numbers.

heading: Tool Spotlight: SIP Growth Calculator
body: See exactly how a monthly SIP grows over 10, 20, or 30 years at different assumed return rates, with a year-by-year breakdown — useful for sanity-checking whether your current SIP amount actually gets you to your goal on time.

heading: Tool Spotlight: Net Worth Tracker
body: A simple quarterly net-worth tracker (assets minus liabilities) matching the tracking habit we recommend over daily portfolio-checking. Fill in your numbers each quarter and watch the trend line, not the noise.

heading: Tool Spotlight: Emergency Fund Planner
body: Calculates your target emergency fund (3-6 months of expenses, adjustable for self-employed income volatility) and tracks your progress toward it month by month.

heading: Tool Spotlight: Loan Prepayment Calculator
body: Enter your loan details and see exactly how much interest and tenure a given prepayment amount saves you — turns the 'should I prepay?' question into a concrete number instead of a guess.

heading: Tool Spotlight: Annual Financial Checklist
body: A one-page checklist covering insurance renewal, nominee updates, tax-saving deadlines, and portfolio review dates — the kind of admin that's easy to forget until it's overdue.
